consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking 'does the player's crafting inventory hold item_count of item_id?' to decide whether the fetch objective is met
scope: items reachable nearby via crafting_inventory() (carried plus adjacent/reachable craftable items), not just the character's own on-person carried items
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) — calls u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(type->item_id, item_count) (with a has_charges fallback) and returns that boolean as the completion verdict
divergence: the required part sits on an adjacent reachable tile within crafting range but is not carried: real is_complete via crafting_inventory() returns met, while an on-person-only has_amount tally (Excerpt 1) wrongly reports the objective unmet
